content.short: Diagonal Finance is the API for crypto payments across multiple chains and tokens.
content.description: Diagonal Finance provides a crypto payments API that enables businesses and creators to monetize with crypto-native subscriptions across multiple chains and tokens, including Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, BNB Chain, Base, and Multichain. It supports fixed, usage-based, seat-based, and Superfluid streaming subscription models, letting you tailor pricing to your audience. The integration requires just seven lines of code, delivering a lightweight yet capable connection that helps you focus on running your business.
